# sanity Provider

Interact with Sanity.io platform resources (projects, datasets, CORS origins, webhooks).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Sanity API token. Can also be set via the SANITY_TOKEN environment variable.
- `api_version` (String) Sanity API version to use (e.g. v2024-01-01). Defaults to v2024-01-01. Can also be set via SANITY_API_VERSION.
